density_convention: n = rho/m_H; pure atomic H; P/k_B = n T
stability: Isobaric local thermal mode at equilibrium, without conduction: d ln Lambda / d ln T > 1 is stable. Finite-wavelength conduction is not included in this branch label.
scope: Equilibrium benchmark of the corrected analytic fit, not a rerun or digitization of the 2002 multidimensional simulation; not a full chemistry or ionization calculation. The 10--10000 K interval is a plotting choice, not a claim of physical accuracy throughout it.
